Container.Name: Holiday-Radio-Monitor
Container.Overview:
Monitors holiday radio streams (Halloween, Christmas and anything else you add), identifies every song that airs, and builds playlists from them.
Songs are matched against MusicBrainz and Spotify using artist, title and track-length agreement. Confident matches are added to a Spotify playlist and written to .m3u8 files automatically. Anything the matcher is unsure about is held in a review queue so you can pick the right track yourself — and every choice you make is remembered, so that song matches instantly forever after.
Station jingles and IDs are detected and filtered out so they never reach a playlist.
Point it at any AzuraCast, Icecast or SHOUTcast stream. The Stations tab can discover every station on an AzuraCast server and add them in one click.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface. The WebUI button opens this.

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Database, settings and your Spotify link live here. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Playlists Folder
Config.Description: Where generated .m3u8 playlist files are written. Point this at a share your music player can read.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for timestamps in the interface.

Config.Name: Access Token
Config.Description: Optional. Set a value to require this token before the interface opens. Leave blank for open access on your LAN.

Config.Name: Spotify Redirect URI
Config.Description: Optional override. Only needed if you reach the app through a reverse proxy - set it to https://your.domain/api/spotify/callback and add the same value to your Spotify app settings.
